raw_prompt: Build an export pipeline that strips 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor direct identifiers before analytics ingestion.

export pipeline.rationale: ETL batch/streaming pipeline aggregate transferring data to analytics sink.

export.rationale: Dynamic action and system workflow of extracting data records.

18 HIPAA Safe Harbor direct identifiers.rationale: Statutory regulatory privacy rule (45 CFR § 164.514(b)(2)) defining the de-identification constraint.

patient records.rationale: Primary domain data model and core entity aggregate containing clinical and demographic PHI.

analytics ingestion.rationale: Downstream storage / query warehouse destination aggregate.
